subject: Error in measurement invariance model with WLSMV

messages.author: fc265c98f90a8895
messages.subject: Error in measurement invariance model with WLSMV
parts:
Hi,

I am working on a measurement invariance model. I was testing threshold invariance across  groups and had following error:
Error in if (!all(ustart1 == LIST$ustart[fixed.all])) { :
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

What could be causing this problem? how can I fix it?

my script is like this:
str<-"y=~dass21_1+dass21_6+dass21_8+dass21_11+dass21_12+dass21_14+dass21_18"

fit_s3<-lavaan(str,data=L8,group="land",estimator="WLSMV",parameterization="theta",ordered=c("dass21_1","dass21_6","dass21_8","dass21_11","dass21_12","dass21_14","dass21_18"),group.equal=c("loadings","thresholds"))

summary(fit_s3,fit.measures=TRUE)

Thank you.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Error in measurement invariance model with WLSMV
parts:
Does the error occur when you call lavaan() or summary()?  Does it occur when you call cfa() instead of lavaan()?  That might trigger some smart defaults that avoid the starting-value issue.

this error occurs when I call lavaan(). But it doesn't occcur when I call cfa() instead of lavaan(). this solved my problem :)
